# Timeline of Modern Approaches for Fraud Detection in Highly Imbalanced Transaction Datasets

**Question:** Compare modern approaches for detecting fraud in highly imbalanced transaction datasets, including how such models should be evaluated.

## Summary

Random Forest with SMOTE-ENN achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.85, balancing precision and recall. [S5] LSTM models paired with SMOTE-ENN delivered an AUC-ROC of 0.90. [S5] The random forest model achieved an accuracy of 99.95%. [S2] The random forest model achieved an F1 score of 0.8256. [S2] The random forest model achieved an ROC-AUC of 0.9759. [S2] The deep learning model provided the highest precision. [S2]

## Limitations

- The evidence does not specify the exact conditions under which oversampling or undersampling leads to model degradation in fraud detection.
